production.note: One US model year. BMW NA: 'Available only for the 2022 model year, the new limited production super sedan' and 'Limited to one model year only. U.S. arrival 2nd half of 2021.'

body.note: Table: 'Seats | 4', 'Number of Doors | 4'; 'For the first time, the M5 features a four-passenger seating configuration'.

aspiration.note: 'The liquid-to-air intercooling for the two turbochargers'.

fuel.note: Inferred from the panel's description: 'twin-turbocharged and intercooled DOHC 32-valve V-8 ... direct fuel injection'.

drivetrain.note: 'The rear-biased M xDrive all-wheel drive system'. C/D panel: 'all/rear-wheel-drive' (M xDrive has a selectable 2WD mode).

transmission.note: 'The eight-speed M Steptronic transmission' (table: 'Transmission type | M8HP76'), a torque-converter automatic and the only transmission.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Engine power | hp | 627 @ 6,000 rpm"; text: 'The S63 4.4-liter M TwinPower turbo V8 has been tuned to deliver 627 hp at 6,000 rpm'. C/D panel (cd-2022-m5-cs): "Power: 627 hp @ 6000 rpm".

weightLb.note: 2022 M5 CS, the only configuration (8-speed automatic, M xDrive), manufacturer step 1. Quote: "Curb weight | lbs. | 4,114". Car and Driver's road-test panel gives 4,096 lb (see discrepancies).

discrepancies.reason: Manufacturer curb weight vs Car and Driver's road-test curb weight ('Curb Weight: 4096 lb') of the test car.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 4,114 lb: a manufacturer curb weight exists (weight step 1), so the step-2 panel figure is not used.
